title: Cryptography
description: A secret only stays secret if breaking it takes longer than the secret matters. Unlocks the One-Time Pad.

puzzle.goal: A key has b bits, and a machine can try s keys a second. Write the longest time T it can take to find the key by trying them all.
puzzle.name: Brute force
puzzle.ask: Find T for b = @{b} and s = @{s}.
puzzle.method: There are 2^b keys to try; each extra bit doubles the work, which is why 128 bits is out of reach.
